style: Warm 2D storybook editorial illustration for a history-of-cities documentary video: flat vector shapes with subtle paper grain, warm cream and parchment palette with terracotta, deep teal and stone-grey accents, architectural and urban motifs, dramatic cinematic lighting, consistent character design, wide cinematic framing, clear separation between foreground and background planes so layers can move independently, NO text, no letters, no numbers, no digits, no watermark, no logos, no UI elements.
